documentDescription: API Reference for the generateViewport function.
content:
You can customize the initial viewport of the page with the static viewport object or the dynamic generateViewport function.

Good to know:The viewport object and generateViewport function exports are only supported in Server Components.You cannot export both the viewport object and generateViewport function from the same route segment.If you're coming from migrating metadata exports, you can use metadata-to-viewport-export codemod to update your changes.
